connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Direct edge feed: the 50 ohm line touches the radiating edge y=-3.251 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)

patch_polygon_mm: rectangle with 4.92 x 2.0 mm feed notch
US3_MS1.note: Single variable: the inset notch is removed (direct edge feed). L, W, U-slot, material, h, board, 50 ohm line width and port unchanged.

rationale: US3_MS2: US3_MS1 with the feed notch removed. Round 21 found Re Zin ~300 ohm and Q ~27 with the 2.0 mm inset; the notch removed ~43 % of the radiating edge. A guide estimate (US3_MS1 Q 27.5) says a single lambda/4 transformer onto the inset cannot meet -6 dB over the channel, so the edge resistance and Q of the un-notched patch are measured first. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11 claimed.

computation.method: Hammerstad-Jensen microstrip; cavity scaling of L by the EM-fitted fr; cos^2 inset law anchored on the US3 circuit fit. GEOMETRY_ONLY.

purpose: EM characterisation step required before a quarter-wave transformer (round-21 next_task: edge feed without notch after an R_edge check). The 50 ohm line equals the port reference, so de-embedding the 9.749 mm line is a pure phase rotation (ideal-line assumption, step/edge parasitics stay in the result).

pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Removing the notch restores the radiating edge: guide-fit loaded Q at the patch < 20 (US3_MS1: 27.5) and radiation efficiency > 0.70 (US3_MS1: 0.50-0.56), Dmax within 20 deg of broadside.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: R_edge (Re Zin peak de-embedded to the patch edge) is in 150-500 ohm (guide range: cos^2 anchor 185 ohm; single-slot edge conductance ~485 ohm).
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: If H1 holds: next round designs a lambda/4 transformer with Zt = sqrt(50*R_edge_EM). If H1 fails (Q >= 20): a single lambda/4 cannot give -6 dB over 6.25 % (VSWR-3 BW ~ 2/(Q sqrt3) < 5.8 %); report and reconsider topology.
pre_registered_hypothesis.note: S11 at the line start is NOT expected to meet -6 dB (direct 50 ohm edge feed into a high-impedance edge).
